propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a short reminder when the command invokes grep-family tools (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep)

The reminder message must be non-blocking, 2-3 lines, and name both Serena's find_referencing_symbols as the preferred path AND the exceptions where grep is still correct (string literals, line numbers)
The hook trigger must use a dumb string match on grep-family commands with no pattern classification or path heuristics, to avoid fragile mis-fires
The hook must emit JSON output to hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext so the reminder surfaces to the model, and must never emit permissionDecision or exit non-zero
The hook script must be testable in scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py and validated against the documented PreToolUse stdin envelope
The .claude/settings.json change must merge with story C's existing env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting rather than overwrite it
